messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm planning a small runtime tweak deploy in ~15min (15:10 PT). Canary on 2 us-west-2 nodes, then 5% traffic for 10m before scaling. Who's on rollback/oncall?
kevin: I'm the rollback owner. I ran the rollback script yesterday, should be ready. Ping me if canary error rate >0.5% or p95 spikes.
samir: Obs checklist (short):
• dashboards pinned: /dashboards/serving/p95-latency, /dashboards/serving/errors, /dashboards/model-cache/hits
• traces: enable detailed sampling for canary trace stream (tag: deploy=1852456789)
• alerts: lower the p95 alarm to 1200ms for the window, and set temporary error-rate alert to 0.5%
• smoke tests: curl /health and a small generate call against canary instance
maria: copying that into the runbook. Thanks. @jlee can you run the smoke tests once canary is up?
jlee: yep. I'll run:```bash
# health
curl -sS -I https://canary-usw2.redwood.internal/health
# quick gen
curl -sS -X POST https://canary-usw2.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":8}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST'
```I'll paste outputs here.
deploy-bot: canary-started deploy=deploy-1852456789 group=runtime us-west-2 nodes=2
maria: canary is up per deploy-bot. jlee, go ahead when ready.
jlee: smoke health: 200 OK
jlee: generate: 200, response time 210ms, token count 7 — sample looks good :thumbsup:
infra-bot: metric-sample p95_latency=210ms error_rate=0.05% host=canary-1
samir: metrics look clean. I'll temporarily lower the p95 alert threshold and mute noisy infra alerts for the next 20m.
kevin: I'm watching logs for 429/503s and the KV-cache eviction chatter. If I see >3 evictions/min sustained I'll rollback.
maria: timeline: canary 10m -> evaluate traces + crashloop events -> if clean, ramp to 5% for 10m, then to full. Rollback window until 15:45 PT.
natalie: small QA note — will hit the /metrics-export endpoint after the 5% ramp to capture distribution for the new kernels.
samir: added trace tag and dashboard link to the runbook: https://console.redwood/d/serving/1852456789-canary (use 'canary' filter)
maria: final call — any blockers or objections?
kevin: none, monitoring in place.
natalie: go from me.
maria: ok proceeding to 5% ramp in 3m. I'll post updates here.
deploy-bot: ramped deploy=deploy-1852456789 to 5% traffic at 15:25 PT
jlee: running post-ramp smoke: generate 250ms, p95 260ms, no errors.
samir: traces show a single slow outlier (1.8s) tied to a cold-start on canary-2, not systemic. I'll annotate.
kevin: still clear, no evictions spike.
maria: thanks everyone. Holding for the remainder of the window, will post go/no-go at 15:45 PT.
infra-bot: alert-thresholds temporary: p95=1200ms error_rate=0.5% muted_alerts=[disk_io_high] until 15:50 PT
maria: GO from me — ramping to full in 5. Will keep an eye for 30m and rollback if anything crosses the thresholds. :rocket:
